name: streetlight_led
_doc: ledger 0056 — modern LED street light. Frame: metres, +x road-ward, +y up, origin = pole axis at the road datum. Read by tools/author_lamps_blend.py (placement) and tools/verify_race.py (mast footprint).

sources.pole_height: Caltrans Standard Plan ES-6A (Lighting Standard, Types 15 and 21): Type 21 pole 35'-0"
sources.arm: ES-6A mast-arm lengths 6/8/10/12/15 ft; City of San Diego SDE-101: arm 8' max (concrete/fiberglass), 12' for Type 15 (steel)
sources.mounting_height: ES-6A Type 21 + 12 ft arm = 38'-9" (Type 15 + 12 ft arm = 33'-9"); SDE-101's own table tops out at 30' for its 250 W HPS / 180 W LPS arterial lamp
sources.pole_od: ES-6A Type 21 base OD 8-5/8"; 0.14 in/ft taper
